summary: East St. Louis School District 189 urges the FCC to preserve E‑Rate funding and to treat student screen‑time concerns separately from the program, citing equity, budget, and infrastructure needs. East St. Louis School District 189 urges the FCC to preserve E‑Rate funding, oppose any sunset or substantial cuts, and keep screen‑time policy separate from connectivity support.
